build_sam3vl_backbone: build a SAM3VLBackbone combining a vision backbone and a text encoder with activation checkpointing
run_sam3vl_forward: run the SAM3VLBackbone forward pass with image samples and text captions to get vision and language features
build_sam3vl_backbone_tri: build a SAM3VLBackboneTri with triple-head vision support for sam3, interactive, and propagation outputs
run_vision_only_forward: run the VisionOnly forward pass with image samples to extract vision features and positional encodings
run_trihead_vision_only_forward: run the TriHeadVisionOnly forward pass with conditional sam3, interactive, and propagation output flags
